rationale: This is a tag-triggered release workflow (build/publish to PyPI, create GitHub release, then build and upload binary matrix artifacts). I evaluated the candidate patterns against the workflow and repository files: P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is not applicable because an equivalent cache already exists — release-pypi already uses actions/setup-python@v7 with cache: pip, and binary already caches Rust compilation via mozilla-actions/sccache-action, so adding another dependency cache would be redundant (contraindication: "An equivalent cache already exists"). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is contraindicated because every matrix outcome is required — binary builds release artifacts for five OS targets and already sets fail-fast: false, so cancelling remaining jobs would drop required release outputs. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because this is release/deployment work. P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW is contraindicated because each tag release is a required contract and all triggers must execute. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT and P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT have unmet preconditions — ci_history reports no completed runs / not a measured baseline, so there is no representative successful-duration history from which to derive a safe timeout. No supported optimization preserves the required release coverage while satisfying its preconditions and avoiding its contraindications, so no change is made.
